text:
maria: Heads up — JP Tech just pushed a swing on the H100 top-off. Partial batch hit a paperwork/customs snag at the APAC hub. PO `5012-APAC-03`. 18 units in the shipment, 6 flagged for depot inspection (potential DOA). ETA delta: +3–5 days currently. Need quick call on whether we split replacements (air) vs consolidate to a single EU depot RMA and regional rebook.
ben_ops: Ack. How many units would be re-shipped air vs depot?
maria: Vendor proposed 4 immediate air replacements to APAC + 2 depot RMA (EU). Air cost delta ~= $12k. Consolidation to FRA depot reduces number of AWBs but adds 24–48h handling.
sam_supply: Staging all 6 to FRA depot seems cleaner — diagnostics in one place, then regional re-dispatch. Avoids two international AWBs and duplicate insurance filings. Downside: extra handling fee in FRA (~€600) and time.
erin_sre: From infra side, can we temporarily borrow Dedicated pool capacity? If we route the re-ships to eu-west and apac we need to ensure node tags allow the new hosts to join without routing churn. We have ~20% buffer but need to pin by policy.
maria: We can create a short-term routing policy: prefer regional pools, fallback to eu-dedicated for APAC overflow. That keeps latency within SLO for onboarding traffic.
vendor_jp: Confirming we can consolidate at FRA depot and amend the manifest, but need notice by EOD to change carrier instructions. We can absorb up to $8k brokerage if RMA is filed within 48h of arrival. If you choose air re-ship, we will quote updated AWB and expedite fees.
ben_ops: Quick cost calc — air option: +$12k vendor quote, plus APAC customs hold risk. Consolidate option: +€600 handling + our internal staging ops (~$4k labor/transport) — net ~ $5k. With vendor covering $8k brokerage, consolidation looks cheaper.
sam_supply: Agree. Consolidation reduces operational complexity and insurance churn. Can we request vendor to provide provisional manifest amendment and photos of the flagged units (serials) before routing?
vendor_jp: Will provide manifest amendment and unit photos in the next update. Please confirm which depot address to use (we will need depot contact + hours).
logistics-bot: Insurance reminder — open claim code INS-2026-77 if any units are confirmed DOA on arrival. Post receipts in `#vendors-claims`.
ben_ops: Product note — we have several customer onboards waiting on the top-off. If consolidation adds >48h to usable inventory, we may need to greenlight 2 immediate air replacements to preserve PLG momentum. Tradeoff: extra cost.
maria: Decision: proceed with consolidation to FRA as primary plan, but keep vendor air option as standby for 2 units if diagnostics show >2 DOA. Sam, please file the FRA depot contact and confirm staging SLA. Ben/Erin, please draft the temporary routing policy for Dedicated fallback and pin affected routes. I will confirm with @vendor_jp and ask for manifest amendment by EOD.
sam_supply: Will file depot contact and SLA now, tagging `#ops-logistics`.
erin_sre: Starting a config patch for routing policy — will post PR and rollout window.
vendor_jp: Understood. Manifest amendment ETA: 6 hours. We will include serial photos and provisional AWB for FRA consolidation.
maria: Thanks — will update thread as soon as vendor sends docs. cc @logistics-bot for insurance checklist. :thumbsup:
